name: claude-code-guardrails
description: Safety presets for Claude Code: a PreToolUse hook that denies or asks before risky shell commands and file edits, and costs no tokens when it has nothing to say.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks rm -rf on a root or home folder, force pushes to protected branches, secrets in commits and .env edits, and asks before resets, publishes, destroys and curl | sh. Three presets (strict, balanced, relaxed); zero tokens for every allowed call.
